title: catalog.item_deactivated v1
description: FLAT payload (does NOT use the envelope.v1 data-nested shape) — fields are top-level, matching the real producer. Emitted when a catalog item is deactivated (soft-disabled). Source publisher: alebrije-mod-catalog-go RedisPublisher.PublishItemDeactivated (internal/service/redis_publisher.go:233-235), which XADDs the SAME itemPayload(it) helper (redis_publisher.go:212-220) used by PublishItemCreated/PublishItemUpdated to the configured stream (default 'catalog.item_deactivated', config.go:190, env EVENTBUS_STREAM_CATALOG_ITEM_DEACTIVATED). Registered under the producer's real event_type key ('catalog.item_deactivated', underscore) — no schema previously existed for this event type at all (ErrNoSchema fail-open); the pre-existing 'catalog.item.stock_depleted.v1.json' schema is a different, orphaned name with zero producers found in this service (out of scope here — additive-only task). 'event_type' is documentary only per catalog.item_created.v1.json's precedent — itemPayload never embeds it. DEBT-AUDIT-20260701-019-catalog-crm-agenda.

event_type.description: Documentary only — never present on the real wire payload; itemPayload (redis_publisher.go:212-220) does not set this key.

item_id.description: UUID of the deactivated catalog item (it.ID.String(), redis_publisher.go:214).

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit code, unique per tenant (it.SKU, redis_publisher.go:216).

name.description: Item display name at deactivation time (it.Name, redis_publisher.go:217).

item_type.description: Catalog entry kind (it.ItemType, redis_publisher.go:218). Left unconstrained — see catalog.item_created.v1.json for the enum-ambiguity rationale.
